3. Saves to /root/sc100-filled.pdf

Use pypdf (PdfReader/PdfWriter). For checkboxes, you'll need to figure out the appearance state name (usually "/Yes" or "/1" or "/On").

Here's the script to run:

```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import NameObject, ArrayObject

reader = PdfReader('/root/sc100-blank.pdf')
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.append(reader)

# First, discover checkbox on-states
print("=== Discovering checkbox states ===")
for page_num, page in enumerate(writer.pages):
    if '/Annots' in page:
        for annot in page['/Annots']:
            obj = annot.get_object()
            ft = str(obj.get('/FT', ''))
            if 'Btn' in ft:
                t = str(obj.get('/T', ''))
                ap = obj.get('/AP')
                if ap:
                    n = ap.get('/N')
                    if n and hasattr(n, 'keys'):
                        keys = [str(k) for k in n.keys()]
                        print(f'Page {page_num}: {t} -> states: {keys}')

print("\n=== Now filling form ===")

# Define text field values
text_fields = {
    # Page 2 - Plaintiff
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].PxCaption[0].Plaintiff[0]': 'Joyce He',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List1[0].Item1[0].PlaintiffName1[0]': 'Joyce He',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List1[0].Item1[0].PlaintiffPhone1[0]': '4125886066',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List1[0].Item1[0].PlaintiffAddress1[0]': '655 S Fair Oaks Ave',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List1[0].Item1[0].PlaintiffCity1[0]': 'Sunnyvale',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List1[0].Item1[0].PlaintiffState1[0]': 'CA',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List1[0].Item1[0].PlaintiffZip1[0]': '94086',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List1[0].Item1[0].EmailAdd1[0]': 'he1998@gmail.com',
    
    # Page 2 - Defendant
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List2[0].item2[0].DefendantName1[0]': 'Zhi Chen',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List2[0].item2[0].DefendantPhone1[0]': '5125658878',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List2[0].item2[0].DefendantAddress1[0]': '299 W Washington Ave',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List2[0].item2[0].DefendantCity1[0]': 'Sunnyvale',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List2[0].item2[0].DefendantState1[0]': 'CA',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List2[0].item2[0].DefendantZip1[0]': '94086',
    
    # Page 2 - Claim amount and description
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List3[0].PlaintiffClaimAmount1[0]': '1,500.00',
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List3[0].Lia[0].FillField2[0]': 'Defendant failed to return my security deposit of $1,500 based on the signed roommate sublease contract after moving out.',
    
    # Page 3 header
    'SC-100[0].Page3[0].PxCaption[0].Plaintiff[0]': 'Joyce He',
    
    # Page 3 - Dates
    'SC-100[0].Page3[0].List3[0].Lib[0].Date1[0]': '2025-09-30',
    'SC-100[0].Page3[0].List3[0].Lib[0].Date2[0]': '2026-01-19',
    
    # Page 3 - How tried to resolve (item 3c)
    'SC-100[0].Page3[0].List3[0].Lic[0].FillField1[0]': 'I asked defendant to return the money multiple times via text but he is not responding.',
    
    # Page 3 - Item 6: number of other small claims in past 12 months
    'SC-100[0].Page3[0].List6[0].item6[0].ZipCode1[0]': '0',
    
    # Page 3 - Item 8: date
    'SC-100[0].Page3[0].List8[0].item8[0].Date4[0]': '2026-01-19',
    
    # Page 4 header
    'SC-100[0].Page4[0].PxCaption[0].Plaintiff[0]': 'Joyce He',
    
    # Page 4 - Signature
    'SC-100[0].Page4[0].Sign[0].Date1[0]': '2026-01-19',
    'SC-100[0].Page4[0].Sign[0].PlaintiffName1[0]': 'Joyce He',
}

# Fill text fields using update_page_form_field_values approach
# We need to do it page by page
for page_num in range(len(writer.pages)):
    page = writer.pages[page_num]
    if '/Annots' not in page:
        continue
    for annot in page['/Annots']:
        obj = annot.get_object()
        field_name = str(obj.get('/T', ''))
        ft = str(obj.get('/FT', ''))
        
        # Build full name by traversing parent chain
        full_name = field_name
        parent = obj.get('/Parent')
        while parent:
            p = parent.get_object()
            pt = str(p.get('/T', ''))
            if pt:
                full_name = pt + '.' + full_name
            parent = p.get('/Parent')
        
        if full_name in text_fields and 'Tx' in ft:
            writer.update_page_form_field_values(
                page, {full_name: text_fields[full_name]}
            )
            print(f'Set text: {full_name} = {text_fields[full_name]}')

# Now handle checkboxes
# We need to check them by finding the right annotation and setting its value

# Checkboxes to enable:
# - Checkbox1 (plaintiff is individual) on Page 2
# - Checkbox4 (defendant is individual) on Page 2  
# - Checkbox5cb under Lia (item 5a - where defendant lives) on Page 3
# - Checkbox50[0] (item 4 - first radio option) on Page 3 -- filing where defendant lives
# - Checkbox60[0] (item 7 - has NOT filed 12+ claims) on Page 3
# - Checkbox61[0] (item 8 - first option) on Page 3
# - Checkbox62[0] (item 9 - first option) on Page 4
# - Checkbox63[0] (item 10 - first option) on Page 4

checkbox_targets = {
    # (page, field_name or identifying info): on_value
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List1[0].Item1[0].Checkbox1[0]': True,  # Plaintiff is individual
    'SC-100[0].Page2[0].List2[0].item2[0].Checkbox4[0]': True,  # Defendant is individual
    'SC-100[0].Page3[0].List5[0].Lia[0].Checkbox5cb[0]': True,  # 5a - defendant lives here
    'SC-100[0].Page3[0].List7[0].item7[0].Checkbox60[0]': True,  # Item 7 - No (haven't filed 12+)
    'SC-100[0].Page3[0].List8[0].item8[0].Checkbox61[0]': True,  # Item 8 - first option
    'SC-100[0].Page3[0].List9[0].Item9[0]': None,  # placeholder
    'SC-100[0].Page4[0].List9[0].Item9[0].Checkbox62[0]': True,  # Item 9 
    'SC-100[0].Page4[0].List10[0].li10[0].Checkbox63[0]': True,  # Item 10
}

# Let's try a different approach - directly modify annotations
for page_num in range(len(writer.pages)):
    page = writer.pages[page_num]
    if '/Annots' not in page:
        continue
    for annot in page['/Annots']:
        obj = annot.get_object()
        ft = str(obj.get('/FT', ''))
        if 'Btn' not in ft:
            continue
            
        # Build full name
        field_name = str(obj.get('/T', ''))
        full_name = field_name
        parent = obj.get('/Parent')
        while parent:
            p = parent.get_object()
            pt = str(p.get('/T', ''))
            if pt:
                full_name = pt + '.' + full_name
            parent = p.get('/Parent')
        
        if full_name in checkbox_targets:
            # Find the on-state from AP/N
            ap = obj.get('/AP')
            on_state = '/Yes'  # default
            if ap:
                n = ap.get('/N')
                if n and hasattr(n, 'keys'):
                    for key in n.keys():
                        if str(key) != '/Off':
                            on_state = str(key)
                            break
            
            print(f'Checking checkbox: {full_name}, on_state={on_state}')
            obj[NameObject('/V')] = NameObject(on_state)
            obj[NameObject('/AS')] = NameObject(on_state)

# Also handle item 4 radio - need to check which one means "where defendant lives"
# Checkbox50 is a radio group. Let's check both and set [0]
for page_num in range(len(writer.pages)):
    page = writer.pages[page_num]
    if '/Annots' not in page:
        continue
    for annot in page['/Annots']:
        obj = annot.get_object()
        ft = str(obj.get('/FT', ''))
        field_name = str(obj.get('/T', ''))
        
        # Build full name
        full_name = field_name
        parent = obj.get('/Parent')
        while parent:
            p = parent.get_object()
            pt = str(p.get('/T', ''))
            if pt:
                full_name = pt + '.' + full_name
            parent = p.get('/Parent')

writer.write('/root/sc100-filled.pdf')
print("\nForm saved to /root/sc100-filled.pdf")
```

reader = PdfReader('/root/sc100-filled.pdf')
print("=== VERIFICATION: Reading back filled PDF ===\n")

for page_num, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    if '/Annots' not in page:
        continue
    print(f"--- Page {page_num} ---")
    for annot in page['/Annots']:
        obj = annot.get_object()
        ft = str(obj.get('/FT', ''))
        if not ft:
            continue
            
        # Build full name
        field_name = str(obj.get('/T', ''))
        parts = [field_name]
        parent = obj.get('/Parent')
        while parent:
            p = parent.get_object()
            pt = str(p.get('/T', ''))
            if pt:
                parts.insert(0, pt)
            parent = p.get('/Parent')
        full_name = '.'.join(parts)
        
        if 'Tx' in ft:
            v = obj.get('/V', '')
            if v:
                print(f'  TEXT: {full_name} = "{v}"')
        elif 'Btn' in ft:
            v = str(obj.get('/V', ''))
            as_val = str(obj.get('/AS', ''))
            if v != '' or as_val != '/Off':
                print(f'  CHECKBOX: {full_name} -> V={v}, AS={as_val}')

print("\n=== Verification complete ===")
PYEOF
